headline: The sentence in your head when your baby only wants Dad
body:
~~She likes him better.~~
_She's lucky enough to have two safe places._

~~I'm doing something wrong.~~
_You raised a baby who trusts more than one person._

~~She'll always pick him.~~
_Next month it'll be you, and he'll take it personally._

~~Why does this sting if I'm relieved?~~
_Both are allowed. Hand her over. Drink your coffee hot._
